top.title: Post-Quantum Authentication: Lessons from Prague
top.summary: In October, the Internet Architecture Board (IAB) held a two-day workshop in Prague with people who are deploying post-quantum authentication. These are the first impressions from the co-chairs, ahead of the full workshop report.

top.title: What’s up with email at IETF 127
top.summary: Email is the oldest widely used application on the Internet, but it continues to evolve. At IETF 127 four working groups will meet to improve the security and usability of mail, and two Birds-of-a-Feather sessions propose improvements in mail operations and the way users sign up for mail subscriptions.

top.title: IETF Administration LLC 2027 Draft Budget
top.summary: The IETF Administration LLC has prepared its draft budget for 2027 and now seeks community feedback.

top.title: New features for RFC-Editor.org
top.summary: New features implemented on RFC-Editor.org aim to make the site more useful and engaging for RFC consumers.

top.title: IETF email infrastructure transition completed on 11 September
top.summary: A transition to a new modern, modular, and containerized infrastructure for email services provided for ietf.org, iab.org, irtf.org, rfc-editor.org (including email lists) was completed on 11 September 2026.

top.title: Survey to gather input on ISE selection criteria
top.summary: The Independent Series Editor (ISE) selection criteria survey is live and we welcome your input on the capabilities and expectations the IAB should consider when selecting a future ISE. Please respond by 11 October 2026.

top.title: IETF 126 Highlights
top.summary: The IETF 126 meeting was held 18–24 July 2026 at the Hilton Vienna Park in Vienna, Austria, and online, hosted by Cisco. The week included the IETF Hackathon and Code Sprint, the New Participants' Program, five Birds-of-a-Feather (BoF) sessions, and more than 100 working group and research group sessions. The Applied Network Research Workshop also took place during the IETF 126 meeting week.

top.title: Post-Quantum Authentication: Up Next
top.summary: Post-quantum key establishment has moved from standards into deployment. Post-quantum authentication has not moved nearly as far, and specification work is no longer the only constraint. The IAB is holding a workshop in Prague on 11 and 12 October 2026 to bring deployment experience together with the people working on the relevant protocols and standards.

top.title: IETF 126 post-meeting survey: what we heard
top.summary: The IETF 126 Vienna meeting was held 18-24 July 2026 and the results of the post-meeting survey are now available.

top.title: CVE-2026-123890: Critical Authentication Bypass in VMware vCenter
top.summary: Overview On November 19, 2026, Broadcom published VMware Security Advisory VMSA-2026-0009 , addressing five vulnerabilities in VMware products. The most severe of these, CVE-2026-123890 , is an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel ( CWE-288 ) in the VMware Directory Service component of vCenter. Broadcom assigned the vulnerability a critical CVSSv3 score of 9.8 . A malicious actor with network access to an affected vCenter deployment may exploit CVE-2026-123890 without credentials to bypass authentication and gain unauthorized access to the system as the Administrator user.

Without that follow-through, the immediate incident may be resolved while another attacker still has a way in. In Kubernetes 1.29, the project introduced the nftables backend for kube-proxy, which became GA in 1.33. top.title: CVE-2026-133968 — Project MONAI MONAI Label Path Traversal Vulnerability
top.summary: Project MONAI MONAI Label contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to write arbitrary files outside the intended datastore directory, potentially resulting in remote code execution.

top.title: CVE-2026-134624 — N-able MailAssure (SpamExperts) Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
top.summary: N-able MailAssure (SpamExperts) contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the LDAP synchronization connection check that allows an authenticated API user to connect to arbitrary internal hosts and ports, determine which are reachable, and send crafted data to internal services.

top.title: CVE-2026-129448 — Apache Roller Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
top.summary: Apache Roller contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via the XML-RPC endpoint, which accepts and deserializes vendor extension types before authentication. This CVE covers the same underlying vulnerability as CVE-2026-82384 but applies to a broader range of affected versions.

top.title: CVE-2026-123890 — VMWare vCenter Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability
top.summary: Broadcom VMware vCenter contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel vulnerability in the VMware Directory Service that allows an unauthenticated attacker with network access to vCenter to bypass authentication and gain unauthorized access to the system.

top.title: CVE-2025-42884 — SAP NetWeaver Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Data Query Logic Vulnerability
top.summary: SAP NetWeaver Enterprise Portal contains an improper neutralization of special elements in data query logic vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to disclose or modify server information via injected JNDI environment properties or a URL used during JNDI lookup operations.

top.title: CVE-2026-76466 — Cisco Expressway Series Use of Hard-coded Credentials Vulnerability
top.summary: Cisco Expressway Series contains a use of hard-coded credentials vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated, remote attacker with persistent cookies and network access to execute commands as root on a clustered device via the database service.

top.title: CVE-2024-10441 — Synology DiskStation Manager (DSM) Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output Vulnerability
top.summary: Synology DSM contains an improper encoding or escaping of output vulnerability in the system plugin daemon in Synology BeeStation OS (BSM) that could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via unspecified vectors.

top.title: CVE-2026-40217 — BerriAI LiteLLM Unprotected Alternate Channel Vulnerability
top.summary: BerriAI LiteLLM contains an unprotected alternate channel vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via bytecode rewriting at the /guardrails/test_custom_code URI.

top.title: CVE-2026-90817 — Vanderbilt University Research Electronic Data Capture (REDCap) Code Injection Vulnerability
top.summary: Vanderbilt University Research Electronic Data Capture (REDCap) contains a code injection vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code on the server. An attacker could exploit this via crafted HTTP requests that access an unintended controller route from a public survey context and supply a crafted file-path or stream parameter during data import processing. Exploitation requires knowledge of a valid public survey hash.

top.title: CVE-2026-90436 — Apache Axis Unsafe Reflection Vulnerability
top.summary: Apache Axis contains an unsafe reflection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via a crafted SOAP fault message that causes Axis to load and instantiate an attacker-specified class when a suitable class is available on the application classpath. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.
